name: RetrieveEmailMessages
description: Retrieves email messages from an IMAP server.
author: @gaurav

fields.name: __CredentialId__GeneralCredential
fields.label: Email Credential
fields.description: The Email credential containing valid email and app password which is used to authenticate user requests.

fields.name: RetrieveMode
fields.label: RetrieveMode
fields.description: Specifies the action to perform on the email messages.

fields.name: ImapServer
fields.label: Imap Server
fields.description: The IMAP server address (e.g., imap.gmail.com).Retrieve email messages over the Internet

fields.name: ImapPort
fields.label: Imap Port
fields.description: The port number used to connect to the IMAP server. Default is 993.

fields.name: MailFolder
fields.label: MailFolder
fields.description: The destination mail folder. Required when Operation is set to Move to Mail Folder.

fields.name: UseSsl
fields.label: Use SSL
fields.description: If true, uses SSL encryption for the connection.

fields.name: MarkAsRead
fields.label: Mark As Read
fields.description: If true, marks retrieved emails as read.

fields.name: SecurityProtocol
fields.label: Security Protocol
fields.description: is a set of rules or procedures that govern the transmission and exchange of data between two or more devices over a network.

fields.name: Result
fields.label: Result
fields.description: Returns the response data from mailkit after process the email.
